hero.title: Library - learning space, research and exchange
hero.text: Discover digital services, quiet workspaces and inspiring events - all in one place for study, research and everyday life.

about.title: About the library
about.content: Our library combines modern information services with a comfortable learning environment. In addition to print media, you will find digital resources, flexible workspaces and a range of services. Whether for focused work, creative projects or quick research - the library gives you space, quiet and support.

studySpace.title: Quiet place to study
studySpace.content: The library is a place of calm and concentration. Bright rooms, ergonomic workspaces and a pleasant level of background noise create ideal conditions for productive learning. Visitors find inspiration, support and many ways to deepen their knowledge.

digital.title: Digital services
digital.content: Alongside a large media collection, the library offers many digital services: online catalogs, e-books, databases and tools for academic research. These services enable flexible, location-independent work and support you in study, research and projects.

community.title: Community and events
community.content: As a meeting place for knowledge seekers, the library regularly hosts workshops, readings and information sessions. The open spaces encourage exchange, collaboration and shared learning - for students as well as external guests.

openingHours.title: New opening hours from September
openingHours.content: From September we will have extended opening hours. Monday to Friday: 08:00 - 22:00.

digitalCollection.title: Digital collection expanded
digitalCollection.content: We have added 500 new e-books and 200 journals to our digital collection.

holiday.title: Have a nice holiday!
holiday.content: The library will be closed from 15/08 to 22/08. Enjoy the summer break!
